caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair with a high backrest composed of several horizontal slats. The chair’s primary color is a dark brown, with gold and light tan decorative accents. The top slat of the backrest features a painted urn containing a colorful bouquet of flowers and is highlighted by gold scrollwork. The second slat has floral and geometric designs, while the third slat also displays a floral motif in gold and tan. The chair’s spindles and legs are accented with gold bands. The arms are curved, finished in a medium reddish-brown tone distinct from the rest of the chair, and are attached to vertical supports. The seat is woven in a light tan or natural straw color, distinguished from the rest of the dark wooden frame. The rocker rails at the bottom are smoothly curved, matching the darker wood of the chair. The artist’s signature, “Lawrence Flynn,” is located in the bottom right corner along with a date. The background is plain and off-white, which allows the details and colors of the chair to stand out clearly.
title: Stencilled Rocker
